title: Titanium Heat Exchanger Tube Bundle
function: Seamless tube bundle for shell & tube HX
alloyReason: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni (UNS R53400) is selected for Titanium Heat Exchanger Tube Bundle in chemical processing environments where resistance to HCl and H₂SO₄ at temperatures up to 200°C exceeds the capability of CP grades. The molybdenum and nickel additions stabilize the passive film under reducing acid conditions, extending service life in Seamless tube bundle for shell & tube HX by 3-5× versus unalloyed titanium. This rationale is driven by seamless tube bundle for shell & tube hx and service environment demands.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for heat exchanger geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with SPC sampling
TIG welding Grade 2 with SPC sampling
Hydrostatic shell test with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for seamless tube bundle application
commonFailures: Galvanic acceleration at Ti-steel weld joint - controlled by PTFE insulating gasket + CP adjustment — critical for seamless tube bundle performance

faq.q: How does Titanium Heat Exchanger Tube Bundle perform in chloride-containing process streams?
faq.a: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni is the material of choice for wet chlorine, hypochlorite, and chlorinated organic media where stainless steels (316L, 904L) pit within weeks. The TiO₂ passive film maintains stability in chloride concentrations up to saturated levels at pH 2-12 for seamless tube bundle. No critical pitting temperature up to 260°C — significantly exceeding all stainless steel grades.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Heat Exchanger Tube Bundle orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Heat Exchanger Tube Bundle is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Heat Exchanger Tube Bundle?
faq.a: Each Titanium Heat Exchanger Tube Bundle shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for seamless tube bundle.
